description: Na₂Sm₂B₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.67 Å. There are two inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.54 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) B-O bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.41 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na, one Sm, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Sm atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OSm₄ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Sm and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Sm, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na, one Sm, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, three Sm, and one B atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Sm and one B atom.
